{{Quote|The ''Hardcell'' will get you noticed as you travel the space lanes. Even Corellian cruisers will get out of your way. And if they don't, you can run them over.|Internal [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] memo written to increase orders of the ''Hardcell'' [[Transport/Legends|transport]]|<ref name="Vehicles and Vessels" />}}
The '''''Hardcell''-class interstellar transport''', or colloquially known as the '''Techno Union ship''', was a light [[Capital ship/Legends|capital]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] produced by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] prior to the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ''Hardcell''-class transport was used by both the Techno Union and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. It was known as something of a status symbol among Techno Union officials.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Hardcell-transport_negvv.png|thumb|left|180px|A ''Hardcell''-class interstellar [[Transport/Legends|transport]].]]

The ''Hardcell''-class was a cylindrical, [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]]-hulled vessel just over 220 meters in height, and powered by a cluster of six primary thruster engines. The ''Hardcell''-class did not use conventional [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] for flight, instead using rocket propulsion designed for atmospheric and stellar travel. The transport's drive motors were deployed to generate enough retro-rocket thrust to achieve vertical landings at speeds of up to 800 kilometers per hour.

A set of three landing legs&mdash;sometimes converted into landing claws for operations on low-gravity worlds&mdash;were deployed from the underside of the transport to stabilize its landing. The ''Hardcell''-class could achieve takeoff at speeds of 4,000 kilometers per hour, though in space, the vessel was capable only of a relatively slow sublight speed of 40 [[Megalight|MGLT]].

The interior of the ''Hardcell''-class was designed in a stacked formation, to capitalize upon the vessel's vertical landing position. Banks of [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] connected each deck.

Much of the interior of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-operated ''Hardcell''-class transports was given up to storage of droid forces; a standard ''Hardcell''-class transport could carry hundreds of [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|''Hailfire''-class tanks]] and missile ammunition in quick-deployment rigs, and, following the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], legions of [[IG lancer droid/Legends|IG-series battle droids]].
[[File:Providence_hardcell.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A ''Providence''-class destroyer with two ''Hardcell''-class transports.]]

The transport was crewed by organics, with crew and medical quarters located in the conical nose. Most had pressurized cabins so that [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoans]] could remove their [[Pressure suit/Legends|pressure suits]]. This area also contained an advanced sensor array and secure communications equipment to maintain contact with the [[Interstellar Stock Exchange/Legends|Interstellar Stock Exchange]].

''Hardcell''-class transports were not designed for combat, though they were afforded meager protection with a ring of turret-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] around the fuselage and [[assault concussion missile launcher]]s.<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

In a battle situation, the most effective tactic for a ''Hardcell''-class transport crew was to flee into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], utilizing the vessel's Class One [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] to make a speedy retreat.

==History==
{{Quote|Aim right above the fuel cells!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
[[File:Techno_union_transport.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Hardcell on Geonosis]]
Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], these vessels were deployed to travel between star systems for striking business deals, scouting and collecting taxes from member companies. Six ''Hardcell''-class transports were used in the [[Special Task Force One|fleet]] [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]] was assigned to destroy [[Outbound Flight Project|''Outbound Flight'']]. All six were destroyed by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces before ''Outbound Flight'' arrived at their position.<ref name="OF" />

286 ''Hardcell''-class transports were stationed on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] when the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] launched its first offensive of the Clone Wars. Many were shot down by Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], but 169 of these managed to escape the battle, including the personal, modified vessel belonging to Techno Union [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]]&mdash;in which Tambor installed a powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] generator and a series of synchronized scanners to sweep the vessel for tracking or listening devices.

During the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] found and exploited a weakness in the ''Hardcell''-class design, ordering his gunners to aim their missiles directly above the transport's fuel cells, at the joint between the upper and lower halves of the ship. Filled with thousands of gallons of fuel, the rupture of the engines caused massive explosions that rent the vessel in two. After the battle the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] supplied the CIS with a thousand more ships of that class.<ref name="TCWCG" /> A downed ''Hardcell''-class transport was located at [[Checkpoint Alpha]]. It was seized by the Republic during the battle.
